title: Show HN: Auto Dismiss Mac OS "Allow to find devices on local networks?"
summary: This popup has been a constant gripe of mine for years. I almost NEVER want to allow this permission and there is no system setting to disable it globally and prevent the popup from interrupting your typing, etc. This tiny swift app I built will autoclose it in 1/4th of a second
reason: Show HN item is a small Swift macOS utility for dismissing a system permission popup; it is not an AI model, research, industry, policy, or open-source AI tool release, so no rule covers it.
